title: Ruleset: field_items
description: rules/<id>/field_items.yaml: the items on the field's ground, the chests and the field's sounds (apps/session: FieldItemsAdapter).

ground_slots.description: How many items lie on the ground at once.

chest_slots.description: How many chests a map holds at once.

reach_cells.description: An item or a chest is in reach within this many cells on each axis.

pickup_sound.description: The sound of picking up an item.

toilet_sound.description: The sound of the partner at the toilet.

sleep_sound.description: The sound of the partner come to the player to sleep.

praise_sound.description: The sound of praising the partner.

scold_sound.description: The sound of scolding the partner.

feed.description: Giving the partner an item from the bag in the field (partner.c: partnerTickFeedItem); without it the item goes to the partner at once.

sound.description: The sound as the player holds the item out.

range_base.description: The take range with a take distance of 0.

range_per_distance.description: What each step of take distance adds to the range.

default.description: The take distance of the species not listed.

species.description: The take distance by species id.

offer_frame.description: The player's offer clip frame past which the partner takes or refuses it.

hand_down_frame.description: The partner's eat clip frame on which the player lowers the hand.

clips.description: The clips, by the original's animation ids.
